description: Probe first. A float segment in a construction, as in <<x::float>>, is written through fz_bs_write_field_ref, which takes a value ref. A raw f64 is therefore boxed (fz_box_float_for_any) just to be written as bytes. fz-nml.7 removed the same boxing for integer and utf segments with fz_bs_write_int, which writes from the raw word. Probe: build <<x::float-64>> 1,000 times from a raw float and count scalar boxes (Process.heap_alloc_stats) on interp, run and build. Prediction: 1,000 boxes on run/build today. Acceptance: a fixture in the fz-nml block shows a scalar_box delta of 0 on all three paths, and the bytes match Elixir (oracle). The fix follows fz_bs_write_int: one raw-word writer per float size and endianness, with no second dispatch.
title: Writing a float segment boxes no float
